why_it_fails: The accepted catalog is WRONG even though it is grade A. (1) Ascend left Dispense for Dutchie; the Dispense venue behind ascendcannabis.com/menu/il-springfield-adams-menu-med is a frozen snapshot (newest product modified 2025-11-11, POS sync disabled), so the 784 accepted offers are about a year old. backend/providers/dispense.fetch only checks that the venue API reconciles to its own advertised count over two traversals, so a frozen catalog passes completeness (completeness grades internal consistency, not data age; the 12h freshness rule applies to fetch time). (2) It is medical-only (license medicinal); the shopper-facing recreational menu is not covered. (3) The endpoint was found by web search/legacy URL (resolution row: no connector configured for Ascend; backend/locators.py CONNECTORS has no ascend entry) and dispense.observe() simply recognised the venueId in the legacy page. The correct source is the Dutchie storefront (1120 products, rec+med in one menu).
fix_idea: Chain-level (fixes all Ascend IL stores at once): add an Ascend connector to backend/locators.py CONNECTORS (r"\bascend\b|inlabs", "https://letsascend.com/wp-json/ascend-store-mapper/v1/locations") plus a GeoJSON branch handler (features[].properties address_1/city/zip_code/shop_url/dutchie_cname, geometry [lng,lat]) matching by addresses_match(registry address, address_1) or the coordinate pin. Resolve shop_url (letsascend.com/stores/<cName>); the existing dutchie_page_endpoints() turns the page dispensaryId into https://dutchie.com/embedded-menu/<id>, and the Dutchie browser path (paged FilteredProducts replay, queryInfo.totalCount, platform-declared location.ln1 address check) then applies. Also: (a) supersede the stale Dispense endpoint 6fd213184942ce9a738d31c7 (Store.supersede_endpoint, keep evidence) and withdraw its offers from /deals; (b) add a source-age guard to providers/dispense.py: if max(product.modified) is older than ~30 days treat as a stale source catalog (new FailureCode), since a frozen Dispense tenant otherwise passes grade A; (c) treat legacy ascendcannabis.com/menu/* as non-canonical (its link rel=canonical already points at letsascend.com).
